machine-readable starter prompts are current with manifest and reference screen examples

tracked public references resolve with no missing source targets

guardrails: Read parent composition before child family documents.
Do not let parent composition override child component recipe.
Do not let foundation documents invent exact component recipes.
Do not promote local usage, example-only, or draft names to canonical truth.
Do not invent missing token values or product-specific data semantics.
Include default, loading, empty, error, disabled, permission, and selected/current states when relevant.
Prefer semantic tokens and document literal fallback only when the source document provides it.
